_comment: The queen sheet is a pose sheet, not a direction x frame grid: the facing
drifts across each row, so cells are picked by hand. [row, col], 1-based.
Row 3 cols 1-2 are her side profile (W); row 3 cols 3-4 plus row 1 col 3 are
the back-turned poses (NW); row 2 cols 1-3 are the front-turned ones (SE).
E, NE and SW are the mirrors of those.
